options.description:
The encoding format of the audio stream. Supported formats:
- PCM: 8, 16, 24, and 32 bits
- A-law: 8 bits
- μ-law: 8 bits
Note: No need to add WAV headers to raw audio as the API supports both formats.

options.description: The endpointing duration in seconds. Endpointing is the duration of silence which will cause an utterance to be considered as finished
